0x102853F0.name: PlaybackChannel_Load
0x102853F0.evidence: reads a version dword and returns 0 with the error 'PlaybackChannel version' unless it is 3, then reads the channel fields through FUN_1028A0F0, allocates the accum, previous and tmpValues buffers and the per-entry data, entry and playback blocks, and the dataType and entryEnabled arrays, calling FUN_10293000 for each entry
0x102853F0.summary: Loads a playback channel of version 3 from a stream, allocating its buffers.
